description: tools/test-projects/animator (WEB_PROJECT=animator tools/build.sh web, and with WASM_SIMD=0 the scalar pose kernels): the animated hero and the A-pose robot play one Animator Controller (the robot retargeted), reach the Move blend tree on a trigger and hold it at 25 %: both are humanoids, and the left feet are where the native build puts them (two decimals). The canvas centre is the background between the two figures.
